verdict.rationale: Linking users to a feedback portal is a fair capability for a feedback-management product like Productboard. The evidence pack never mentions a user-facing feedback portal or a shareable portal link. It covers only the REST API, webhooks, the MCP server and intake integrations, which are different capabilities that do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a link in my product that directs users to the feedback portal
